results.rationale: The Egyptian pyramid becomes a stepped Maya pyramid with broad central stairs and a summit temple, matching the requested form and the supplied Kukulkan identification. Desert foreground and distant horizon remain in place, but the sky gains an obvious brick-like texture. That unnatural sky texture is a clear visual artifact; the pyramid itself is coherent.

The wooden pushpins are entirely replaced by a close-up of manicured fingers, changing the subject and composition. The request meant six of the pictured nails/pins, so this is a complete misinterpretation. Viewed alone, the fingers, nails, lighting and skin textures appear natural and coherent.
